name: Harness Pulse
author: Fred Nix
description: One ring per coding agent on every linked Harness machine. Working throws a comet, waiting breathes a halo toward you, permission strobes red with a glitch, done fills with a burst, failed flashes then holds, offline sits dim. Right-click for a live fleet view: machines with agents in orbit, spend gauges, an activity ticker and a hold-to-stop hexagon. Reads the local Harness daemon's attention feed; nothing leaves the machine.

barWidget.description: Agent attention rings for OpenHarness: which agent is working, which one is waiting on you, which one finished. Right-click for the fleet view.

schema.label: Bar layout
schema.description: Summary: one ring for the most urgent agent and a count. Rings: one ring per agent.

schema.label: Reduced motion
schema.description: Stops every animation on the bar and in the fleet view. States still read from colour, a glyph and a word.

schema.label: Working ring colour
schema.description: Colour of a ring while its agent works. Accent follows your theme.

schema.label: Rings on the bar
schema.description: Most urgent first; the rest are in the fleet view.

schema.label: Harness window class
schema.description: Left-click on a ring focuses the window with this class.

schema.label: Face in a waiting ring
schema.description: Auto: the picture below, else ~/.face, else your initials. Initials: always initials. None: a plain ring.

schema.label: Avatar picture
schema.description: Any square-ish image; it is round-cropped. Empty uses ~/.face.

schema.label: Initials
schema.description: One or two letters. Empty uses the first letter of your user name.

schema.label: Idle and connecting logo
schema.description: Shown in the fleet view when there are no agents or the daemon is not answering. Omarchy reads /usr/share/omarchy/logo.svg at runtime.

schema.label: Custom logo
schema.description: Image used when the logo is Custom (SVG or PNG).
